title: Orrery Workshop
description: Build and tune your own WebGL solar system — orbits, eccentricity, and tilt — then save, share, or screenshot it.
concept: A 3D orbital-mechanics builder rendered in raw WebGL. Add planets to a glowing star, drag sliders to reshape each orbit's distance, eccentricity, inclination, size and speed, then watch true elliptical Kepler-style paths animate in real time. Free-orbit camera or a one-tap top-down view, four starter presets, and full save/share/export tooling round it out.
features: Add, tap-select, and delete orbiting bodies with live orbit-shape editing (distance, eccentricity, tilt, size, speed)
4 starter systems — Solar System, Binary Chaos, Randomize, Empty Space
Free-orbit 3D camera (drag to rotate, scroll/pinch to zoom) plus a one-tap top-down view
Named saves + autosave to localStorage, shareable system link via URL hash, PNG screenshot export, and JSON import/export

interaction.mouse: Drag to orbit the camera, scroll wheel to zoom, click a planet or list entry to select it
interaction.click: Tap a planet in the scene or the body list to open its orbit editor
interaction.touch: One-finger drag to orbit, two-finger pinch to zoom, tap a planet to select it
